name: important_memory
description: A high-priority fact memory tool that saves, lists, and deletes essential user rules, durable project constraints, and key facts. Use whenever the user explicitly communicates vital requirements, fixed preferences, or critical project settings that must survive across sessions. Use this to ensure essential constraints remain permanently accessible across conversation turns.

content.description: Fact content to store. Required for store/update.

key.description: Optional key or title for the fact.

fact_id.description: ID of the fact. Required for update/delete/get.
